# Pixenox

> Pixenox is free, open-source HR management software for small and mid-sized organizations. It covers attendance tracking with GPS and selfie verification, leave management, employee records, performance reviews, and reporting. It can be used as a hosted service or self-hosted with Docker. The guides below are practical HR documentation — policy templates, workflow design, and step-by-step product walkthroughs.

## Guides

- [Install Pixenox as an App (PWA) on Android and iOS](https://pixenox.com/how-to-use/install-pixenox-pwa): Install Pixenox on your phone or desktop as a Progressive Web App PWA — no app store download required.
- [Exporting Employee Data](https://pixenox.com/how-to-use/exporting-employee-data): How to export your employee directory as CSV for data analysis or branded PDF for stakeholder sharing.
- [Subscription and Upgrade Options](https://pixenox.com/how-to-use/subscription-upgrade-options): Pixenox's subscription model explained — Trial, Donation tiers, Ad-Supported free tier, and what happens when your trial expires.
- [Understanding the Dashboard](https://pixenox.com/how-to-use/understanding-dashboard): A detailed tour of Pixenox's role-based dashboard — what each widget shows for Employees, Managers, and Admins.
- [Configuring Notification Settings](https://pixenox.com/how-to-use/notification-settings): How to configure email notifications, enable or disable notification types, set up SMTP, and manage notification retention.
- [Custom Leave Types and Special Leave](https://pixenox.com/how-to-use/custom-leave-types): Understanding all leave types in Pixenox — Maternity, Paternity, Earned, Unpaid, half-day leave, and custom-configured types.
- [Theme Customization](https://pixenox.com/how-to-use/theme-customization): Personalize Pixenox with 14 color themes, dark mode, light mode, and system preference — saved across devices.
- [Notifications — Bell Notifications and Admin Management](https://pixenox.com/how-to-use/notifications-guide): How Pixenox's bell and email notification system works, what events trigger notifications, and how admins manage them.
- [Announcements — Viewing and Creating](https://pixenox.com/how-to-use/announcements-guide): How to view organization announcements in Pixenox, and how Admins can create, target, and manage company-wide communications.
- [Performance Reviews — HR Calibration](https://pixenox.com/how-to-use/performance-reviews-hr-calibration): How HR calibrates performance reviews, assigns final overall ratings, manages review cycles, and completes the process.
- [Performance Reviews — For Managers](https://pixenox.com/how-to-use/performance-review-for-managers): How managers review employee self-assessments, provide competency ratings and feedback, and submit for HR calibration.
- [Performance Reviews — Employee Self-Assessment](https://pixenox.com/how-to-use/performance-review-self-assessment): How to complete your self-assessment in Pixenox — rate competencies, add comments, and submit for manager review.
- [Roles and Permissions in Pixenox](https://pixenox.com/how-to-use/roles-and-permissions): Complete guide to Pixenox's role-based access control — what Admin, HR, Manager, Team Lead, and Employee roles can access.
- [Managing Your Profile and Settings](https://pixenox.com/how-to-use/managing-profile-settings): How to view your employee profile, update your name and email, change your password, and customize your app theme.
- [Generating Reports](https://pixenox.com/how-to-use/generating-reports): How to generate attendance and leave reports in Pixenox, export as CSV or PDF, and email summaries to stakeholders.
- [Setting Up Your Organization](https://pixenox.com/how-to-use/setting-up-organization): Complete admin guide to configuring departments, teams, shifts, GPS locations, leave policies, holidays, and workflows in Pixenox.
- [Managing Employees — Adding and Editing Staff](https://pixenox.com/how-to-use/managing-employees): How admins add new employees, assign roles and departments, manage the employee directory, and export staff data.
- [Understanding Leave Policies](https://pixenox.com/how-to-use/understanding-leave-policies): How leave types, balances, quotas, approval workflows, and holiday exclusions are configured in Pixenox.
- [Leave Approval — For HR and Admins](https://pixenox.com/how-to-use/leave-approval-for-hr): How HR and Admin users verify, approve, reject, and manage leave records with admin override capabilities.
- [Leave Approval — For Managers](https://pixenox.com/how-to-use/leave-approval-for-managers): How managers review, approve, or reject leave requests from direct reports in Pixenox's multi-step approval workflow.
- [How to Apply for Leave](https://pixenox.com/how-to-use/how-to-apply-for-leave): Step-by-step guide to applying for leave in Pixenox — check your balance, submit a request, and track the approval status.
- [Attendance for Admins — Audit and Manual Entries](https://pixenox.com/how-to-use/attendance-admin-audit): How admins can audit attendance records, edit clock-in times, create manual entries, and mark employees as absent.
- [Understanding Your Attendance Logs](https://pixenox.com/how-to-use/understanding-attendance-logs): How to view your personal attendance history, understand attendance status badges, and read consolidated daily records.
- [How to Clock In and Out](https://pixenox.com/how-to-use/how-to-clock-in-and-out): A complete guide to clocking in and out of work using Pixenox's selfie and GPS-based attendance system.
- [Welcome to Pixenox — Your First Steps](https://pixenox.com/how-to-use/welcome-to-pixenox): Complete guide to Pixenox's selfie-based attendance system with GPS location verification, office and factory clock-in modes.
